title: Annotatio II §.I: Triple denomination and history — Consubstantiation, Transubstantiation, Spiritual Presence
pass_a_gloss: Of this triple Opinion there has afterward arisen both a triple Denomination and a triple History — namely of Consubstantiation, of Transubstantiation, and of Spiritual Presence — to be recited by us in a compendium.
pass_b_english: From that triple opinion came a triple name and a triple history: Consubstantiation, Transubstantiation, and Spiritual Presence.
Strimesius will run them in a short compendium.
source_text: Triplicis hujus Sententiae cùm triplex Denominatio, tum triplex Historia, Consubstantiationis puta, Transsubstantiationis, & Spiritualis Praesentiae, postliminiò enata est, per compendium à nobis recitanda.
